title: Pure Ecclesia
summary: The Ecclesia strategy unites the LIGHT Spellcaster incarnations of Ecclesia—Dogmatika Ecclesia, Incredible Ecclesia, Blazing Cartesia, Guiding Quem, and the Level 8 Synchro Ecclesia and the Dark Dragon. Supported by Fallen of the White Dragon (which summons any Ecclesia directly from the Deck) and The Fallen & The Virtuous, the deck rapidly cycles between Level 8 Synchros and Fusions on both players' turns.

allow.Fallen of the White Dragon: Sends a Fusion mentioning Fallen of Albaz from Extra Deck to GY to Special Summon itself, then Special Summons any 'Ecclesia' monster from hand, Deck, or GY.
allow.Fallen of Albaz: Essential partner summoned from the Deck by Incredible Ecclesia and Ecclesia and the Dark Dragon to fuse away opposing monsters.
allow.Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Knighted: Searched by Dogmatika Ecclesia to Special Summon itself as a Quick Effect and negate an opponent's monster.
allow.Dogmatika Punishment: Searched by Dogmatika Ecclesia to send Titaniklad or Granguignol from the Extra Deck to the GY and destroy an opponent's monster.
allow.Nadir Servant: Sends an Extra Deck monster to the GY to search Dogmatika Ecclesia and triggers End Phase recursion for Incredible Ecclesia and Cartesia.
allow.Titaniklad the Ash Dragon: Level 8 Fusion that searches or Special Summons Dogmatika Ecclesia or Guiding Quem during the End Phase when sent to the GY.
allow.Granguignol the Dusk Dragon: Level 8 Fusion summoned by Blazing Cartesia that dumps LIGHT/DARK monsters and tags out into Dogmatika or Despia monsters.
allow.Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon: Level 8 Fusion boss summoned via Fallen of Albaz that banishes opposing monsters and wipes the board if removed.
allow.Albion the Branded Dragon: Level 8 Fusion that Fusion Summons on summon and searches The Fallen & The Virtuous during the End Phase.

main: Incredible Ecclesia, the Virtuous
Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Tuner that Special Summons itself if the opponent controls more monsters, tributes itself as a Quick Effect to summon Fallen of Albaz, and recurs from GY in the End Phase.
Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous
Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster that Special Summons itself when an Extra Deck monster is on the field and searches any Dogmatika card on Normal or Special Summon.
Blazing Cartesia, the Virtuous
Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Tuner that Special Summons itself if Fallen of Albaz is on your field/GY, Quick-Fusions a Level 8+ Fusion during the Main Phase, and recurs in the End Phase.
Guiding Quem, the Virtuous
Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Tuner that dumps Fallen of Albaz or a card mentioning it on Summon, and revives an Ecclesia or Albaz monster whenever a card leaves the Extra Deck.
Fallen of the White Dragon
Treated as Fallen of Albaz on field/GY; sends Titaniklad or Albion from Extra Deck to GY to Special Summon itself and immediately summons any 'Ecclesia' monster from Deck.
Fallen of Albaz
Summoned from Deck by Incredible Ecclesia or Ecclesia and the Dark Dragon to fuse with an opponent's monster into Mirrorjade or Albion.
Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Knighted
Searched by Dogmatika Ecclesia to provide Quick Effect monster negation and boost Attack Position Dogmatikas by 500 ATK.
The Fallen & The Virtuous
Quick-Play Spell that either sends an Albaz Fusion from Extra Deck to GY to destroy a face-up card, OR revives any monster from either GY while you have an Ecclesia on field/GY.
Nadir Servant
Sends Titaniklad or Granguignol from Extra Deck to GY to search Dogmatika Ecclesia from Deck or GY.
Dogmatika Punishment
Normal Trap searched by Dogmatika Ecclesia that sends an Extra Deck monster to the GY to destroy an opponent's monster with equal or lower ATK.
extra: Signature Level 8 Synchro boss that banishes itself until the End Phase as a Quick Effect to summon Fallen of Albaz or a Level 4 monster mentioning it from Deck/GY, and shuffles a card on the field into the Deck from the GY.
Level 8 Fusion summoned by Blazing Cartesia that sends a Level 6+ LIGHT or DARK monster from Deck/Extra Deck to GY.
Level 8 Fusion that Special Summons Dogmatika Ecclesia or Guiding Quem directly from the Deck during the End Phase when sent to the GY.
Level 8 Fusion boss that sends an Albaz Fusion from Extra Deck to GY (triggering Guiding Quem!) to banish a monster on the field.
Level 8 Fusion that sets or searches The Fallen & The Virtuous during the End Phase when sent to the GY.
